note: Scanning-model cohort for context-engine. Prices are USD per 1M tokens, read from OpenRouter's public catalogue on 2026-11-20 and UNVERIFIED at call time. A paid call refuses to start without an explicit budget and records the provider-reported charge when the response carries one; the catalogue product is kept alongside it. Model selection is configuration, not code.

partition.note: GLM Flash's 1.05M window yields ~782k usable input tokens; the operator ceiling of 400k caps a single pass at roughly half of that. Longer subjects partition at this budget, and every split is recorded.

models.notes: Selected default on 2026-11-20: always redirects to the newest GLM Flash. $0.0399/M in, $0.0784/M out, 1.05M context. Because it moves, every call records the response's resolved model id alongside the requested slug; a pinned id remains available for reproducing an old result.
